result.note: Tests the October 2026 trade margin cap on non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs: the cap level and the projected price fall.

questions.prompt: In October 2026, the Centre announced a measure on the pricing of anti-cancer drugs. Consider the following statements about it:
items: It capped trade margins on non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs at 30% of retail price.
Officials projected that the measure would lower prices by up to 30%.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because officials projected price falls of up to 70%. The 30% figure is the trade margin cap itself. The cap targets non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs, which sit outside direct price control.
questions.source: The Centre capped trade margins on non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs at 30% of retail price, with officials projecting price falls of up to 70%.
